T: This drink. I like it. Another.
D: The god of thunder is stripped of his powers and dropped in a small New Mexico town.
P: Serve the drinks when Thor smashes his mug in the diner and asks for another.
S: Thor's first breakfast at the diner
Grated potato squeezed dry, fried in butter in small cakes until crisp, with sour cream and chives.
the small desert town in New Mexico
Melted cheddar and cream cheese with green chillies and tomato, served hot with corn chips.
Chicken wings roasted at 220C for 45 minutes, tossed in a honey, garlic and thyme glaze.
M: the great hall feast in Asgard
Beef ribs rubbed with salt and pepper, cooked at 140C for 5 hours, with roasted root vegetables and crusty bread.
the diner where Thor eats everything in sight
Buttermilk pancakes cooked in butter, stacked high with crisp bacon and fried eggs between the layers, finished with maple syrup poured over the lot.
W: A tall stack of fluffy buttermilk pancakes with butter and maple syrup. Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs and 400ml buttermilk into a thick batter.
K: Thor smashing the mug and asking for another
Strong drip coffee in thick diner mugs, refilled as often as asked.

s.note: Thor's first breakfast at the diner
s.how: Grate 800g potatoes and a small onion, then squeeze out as much liquid as you can. Season well and shape into small flat cakes. Fry in butter over medium heat for 5 minutes a side until deep golden and crisp. Serve hot with sour cream and chives.

Toss 1kg chicken wings with salt and roast at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp. Melt 50g butter with 4 tbsp honey, crushed garlic and thyme leaves. Toss the hot wings through the glaze until shiny and golden and serve on a big platter fit for a feast.

m.note: the great hall feast in Asgard
m.how: Rub 2kg beef short ribs with salt and cracked pepper. Roast covered at 140C for 5 hours until tender. For the last hour, add chunks of carrot, parsnip and potato to the tray to roast in the juices. Serve on a big board with crusty bread.

w.how: Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs and 400ml buttermilk into a thick batter. Cook ladles in a buttered pan for 2 minutes a side and stack with butter and 200ml maple syrup.

d.note: Thor smashing the mug and asking for another
d.how: Brew a big pot of strong drip coffee from freshly ground beans. Pour into thick diner mugs with a splash of milk for anyone who wants it. When a cup is finished, refill it straight away rather than smashing the mug on the floor.
